source_registry.normalized_excerpt: The October 30, 2026 SEC filing states that Advance Funding Subscribers contributed $214,049,995 cash and 600,000 XRP in October 2025. The cash was used to purchase 84,365,876.3625 XRP. The company announced the purchase on November 4, 2025 at an average price of $2.53657058 per XRP. Evernorth reported approximately 473 million XRP held as of October 9, 2026.

source_registry.source_type: SEC Form 424B3; committed equity facility final prospectus
source_registry.normalized_excerpt: The October 30, 2026 final prospectus under Registration No. 333-299620 describes a committed equity facility with CF Principal Investments LLC for up to 5,218,935 shares. Purchases are capped at 19.99% of pre-agreement Class A shares absent stockholder approval; purchase price is 97% of the applicable VWAP, subject to contractual terms; Cantor's beneficial ownership is capped at 4.99%. Evernorth elects whether to sell. The prospectus estimates up to $76.8 million gross proceeds at the October 29 close of $14.71, versus the October 23 preliminary estimate of $80.7 million at the October 22 close of $15.46. The $521,893.50 upfront fee is a company cost, not proceeds.

source_registry.source_type: SEC Form S-1; principal-market accounting policy
source_registry.normalized_excerpt: Evernorth's October 30, 2026 SEC filing states that it selected Coinbase as its principal market for XRP for financial-reporting and impairment purposes after evaluating eligible trading venues. actual_xrp_purchase.interpretation: This is a reported completed purchase from 2025, not a new November 2026 market inflow. Do not use it as current spot demand.

in_kind_contribution_reconciliation.interpretation: The 261.919096M Pubco XRP subtotal is not the full 388.910554M in-kind contribution. Ripple's 126.791458M and delayed-funding 0.2M are separate components.

closing_cash_reconciliation.distinction: Closing gross cash, advance-funding cash used for the 2025 XRP purchase, and in-kind XRP contributions are separate measures. Fees reduced available cash.

convertible_notes.intended_use: General corporate purposes including XRP acquisition
convertible_notes.liquidity_risk: Potential future cash settlement may exceed original proceeds and could require refinancing or XRP sales; it is not a current XRP purchase.

ripple_related_party_facilities.interpretation: These are related-party loan/operating-liquidity channels from Ripple, not equity capital or verified spot XRP purchases.

eloc.interpretation: The $76.8M is a conditional maximum gross-proceeds estimate, not cash received or XRP bought. The $80.7M preliminary estimate uses an earlier share-price vintage.

public_warrants.interpretation: Future conditional proceeds only; not exercisable as of 2026-11-06 and not actual capital.

coinbase_relationship.role: Evernorth selected Coinbase as its principal market for XRP for accounting fair-value and impairment purposes.
coinbase_relationship.interpretation: Accounting principal-market selection is not proof of exclusive trading, custody or a direct partnership.

critical_distinctions: The 84.365876M XRP purchase was announced on 2025-11-04 at $2.53657058; it is not current November 2026 spot demand.
The 388.910554M XRP in-kind contribution is not a cash purchase.
The $272.6M closing gross cash is before expenses and is not the same as the $214.05M advance cash used for the 2025 XRP purchase.
The $30M notes are actual proceeds received on 2026-10-12, but no specific XRP purchase from those proceeds is verified.
Ripple facility funding is debt/operating liquidity, not equity or XRP market buying.
The ELOC $76.8M is conditional future gross proceeds; actual draw and XRP purchase are unverified.
The $132.25M warrant figure is future conditional cash exercise proceeds; warrants were not exercisable until approximately 2027-10-09.
Coinbase is the issuer's accounting principal market, not proof of custody or trading volume.
